blocks.text: Walnut Grove homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Walnut Grove, October 2026. Detached houses: 38 listed at month end and 12 sold in October, a sales ratio of 32% (a sellers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 51 listed at month end and 17 sold in October, a sales ratio of 33% (a sellers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 76 sold over 5 months against an average of 45.6 listed, about 3.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 21 sold. Condos and townhomes: 79 sold over 5 months against an average of 52.4 listed, about 3.3 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 18 sold.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Walnut Grove?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 38 houses listed with 12 sold in the month and 51 condos and townhomes listed with 17 sold in the month in Walnut Grove. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Walnut Grove a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 32%, a sellers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 33%, a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
